proposed_trees.summary: Assistants who worked under Frank Reich as Chargers offensive coordinator (2014-15) and Colts head coach (2018-22), led by Nick Sirianni.

evidence.summary: Jaguars hired Robert Saleh as linebackers coach; he had spent the prior three seasons as Seattle's defensive quality control coach under Gus Bradley.
Titans moved to hire Robert Saleh as head coach; recaps his career including four seasons as Kyle Shanahan's 49ers defensive coordinator (2017-20) and a 2025 return.
Report of the Titans hiring Saleh; notes his 49ers DC tenure under Shanahan from 2017-20 and again in 2025 after the Jets.
Titans hired Gus Bradley as DC; he and Saleh shared staffs in Seattle (2011-12, Bradley DC), Jacksonville (2014-16, Bradley HC) and San Francisco (2025).
Daboll returned to the Patriots in January 2013 to assist offensive coordinator Josh McDaniels, per Belichick.
Daboll left New England to be Alabama's offensive coordinator; had been Patriots tight ends coach three seasons after a 2013 year as offensive assistant under McDaniels.
Sean Payton's Broncos hired recently retired QB Davis Webb as quarterbacks coach.
Payton named Webb offensive coordinator; Webb had been Denver's QB coach since 2023 and pass game coordinator in 2025.
Broncos promoted Webb, their QB coach since 2023, to offensive coordinator under Payton.
Sean Payton's Broncos hired former Denver head coach Vance Joseph as defensive coordinator.
AP source: Payton brought Joseph back to Denver as DC after four seasons as Arizona's DC.
Seattle hired Bradley (given name Casey; then Tampa Bay linebackers coach, ex-North Dakota State) as defensive coordinator and Dan Quinn as defensive line coach/assistant head coach on the same day.
Seattle rehired Dan Quinn, its defensive line coach in 2009 and 2010, as defensive coordinator to replace Gus Bradley, who left for the Jaguars job.
Jon Gruden hired Bradley as Tampa Bay's defensive quality control coach in 2006, promoting him to linebackers coach; Seattle DC from 2009.
New Seahawks head coach Pete Carroll kept Gus Bradley as defensive coordinator.
Colts kept Gus Bradley as defensive coordinator under new head coach Shane Steichen; lists his Seattle DC years as 2009-12.
Colts parted ways with Bradley after he spent Reich's 2022 season and Steichen's first two seasons as DC.
Chiefs promoted running backs coach Eric Bieniemy, on Andy Reid's staff since 2013, to offensive coordinator to replace Matt Nagy.
AP: Reid promoted Bieniemy to OC after five seasons as Chiefs running backs coach, praising his work on the whole offense.
Chiefs promoted Matt Nagy back to offensive coordinator to replace the departed Eric Bieniemy; Nagy had returned to Reid's staff in 2022 after coaching the Bears 2018-21.
Chiefs offensive coordinator Matt Nagy, a longtime Andy Reid assistant, left to become Bears head coach.
Giants hired Nagy as John Harbaugh's OC; he was Chiefs senior assistant/QB coach in 2022 and OC 2023-25 and spent most of his career under Andy Reid.
Chiefs hired Steve Spagnuolo as DC; he coached defensive backs and linebackers under Andy Reid in Philadelphia from 1999 to 2006.
Profile of new Chiefs DC Spagnuolo, recalling his eight Eagles seasons on Reid's staff before the Giants made him DC in 2007.
Eagles moved longtime special teams coach John Harbaugh to secondary coach on Andy Reid's staff.
Harbaugh credits much of his success to his years learning under Andy Reid in Philadelphia.
Harbaugh gained his head-coaching grounding as an Eagles assistant under Reid, mostly as special teams coordinator, before Baltimore hired him in 2008.
Jets hired former Rams assistant Dennard Wilson as defensive backs coach on Todd Bowles' staff.
Giants hired Wilson as DC; his career includes four Jets seasons as DB coach/pass game coordinator, two as Eagles DB coach, and 2023 as Ravens DB coach under John Harbaugh.
Eagles DB coach Dennard Wilson added defensive passing game coordinator duties under DC Jonathan Gannon, describing his job as assisting Gannon and the head coach.
Raiders hired Seahawks OC Klint Kubiak as head coach after Super Bowl LX; previously OC for the Saints (2024) and Vikings (2021); son of Gary Kubiak.
Raiders hired Seahawks QB coach Andrew Janocko as OC; he worked with Klint Kubiak in Minnesota (2019-21), as Saints QB coach under OC Kubiak in 2024, and followed him to Seattle in 2025.
Seahawks hired Janocko as QB coach; he had coached quarterbacks in New Orleans, Minnesota and Chicago and had worked with new OC Klint Kubiak.
Klint Kubiak, Denver's 2022 pass game coordinator/QB coach, was hired onto Kyle Shanahan's 49ers offensive staff.
Leonard, Raiders DL coach since 2023 and run game coordinator in 2025, works under DC Patrick Graham, who also brought him to coach Miami's linebackers and worked with him on the Giants.
Raiders promoted Leonard to DC; career: Giants assistant 2013-18, Dolphins LB/assistant DL coach 2019-21, Ravens OLB coach 2022, Raiders DL coach from 2023.
Brian Flores announced his first Dolphins staff, including Rob Leonard as linebackers coach.
Chargers hired Chris O'Leary as DC; Jesse Minter gave him his first coaching job as a Georgia State graduate assistant (2015) and later brought him to the Chargers as 2024 safeties coach.
AP: O'Leary, Western Michigan DC in 2025, was the Chargers' safeties coach in Jim Harbaugh's first season (2024) and replaces Jesse Minter as DC.
Chargers named McDaniel OC; bio lists Washington 2011-13 and Cleveland 2014 under OC Kyle Shanahan, Atlanta 2015-16, and 49ers run game coordinator 2017-20 and OC 2021 under HC Shanahan.
Dan Quinn's 2016 Falcons staff had Kyle Shanahan as OC and Mike McDaniel as offensive assistant; McDaniel then followed Shanahan to the 49ers.
McDaniel says he is forever indebted to Dan Quinn, who with Falcons coaches Shanahan and Morris confronted him about drinking in January 2016.
Mike McCarthy's Cowboys named 2022 consultant Brian Schottenheimer offensive coordinator, replacing Kellen Moore; McCarthy kept play-calling.
AP: Cowboys promoted consultant Schottenheimer to OC after Moore's exit; his father Marty gave McCarthy his first NFL job.
Cowboys hired Schottenheimer, their offensive coordinator in 2023-24, as head coach.
Stanford hired Klayton Adams from the Colts, where he was assistant offensive line coach 2019-20 and tight ends coach 2021-22.
Colts fired Frank Reich in November 2022 after four and a half seasons as head coach (hired February 2018).
Ex-Colts assistant Klayton Adams accepted the offensive line job on Jonathan Gannon's Cardinals staff.
Cowboys hired Adams as OC after two seasons as Arizona's offensive line coach and four years in Indianapolis.
Cowboys hired Christian Parker as DC; he has worked with Vic Fangio since 2021, when Fangio was Broncos head coach, and coached Eagles DBs/pass game under DC Fangio.
Parker spent the last two seasons as Eagles secondary coach/pass game coordinator after Packers QC and Broncos DB roles.
Pete Carroll's Seahawks were expected to hire former Jets and Rams OC Brian Schottenheimer as offensive coordinator.

Sirianni credits Frank Reich for his development; they worked three years together on the Chargers and three in Indianapolis (Sirianni OC 2018-20), and Reich calls himself the older brother who mentored him.
Eagles hired Sirianni; resume: Chargers QC 2013, QB coach 2014-15, WR coach 2016-17, then Colts OC 2018-20 under head coach Frank Reich.
Eagles hired Packers QB coach Sean Mannion as OC; Matt LaFleur, who had coached him as a player, brought him to Green Bay after his playing career and praised his future.
LaFleur predicted Mannion would excel as Eagles OC; Mannion was a Packers offensive assistant in 2024 and QB coach in 2025.
Bears hired Press Taylor; he spent eight seasons with the Eagles (QB coach, 2020 pass game coordinator) and was an original member of Doug Pederson's Jaguars staff, calling plays 2023-24.
Bears promoted pass game coordinator Press Taylor to OC; career: Eagles 2013-20, Colts 2021, Jaguars OC 2022-24.
Mike McCarthy's Cowboys hired former Falcons head coach Dan Quinn as defensive coordinator.
Commanders hired Quinn as head coach after three seasons running the Cowboys' defense; he had been Seattle's DC for the Super Bowl XLVIII title team.
Commanders promoted assistant QB coach David Blough, on Dan Quinn's staff since 2024, to offensive coordinator.
Column: Dan Quinn hired Blough as assistant quarterbacks coach in February 2024 and is betting on him as OC; Blough finished 2025 as interim QB coach.
Commanders hired Daronte Jones as DC; bio: Dolphins assistant DB coach 2016-17 (under DC Vance Joseph in 2016), Vikings DB coach 2020 and 2022-25, defensive pass game coordinator from 2023.
Jones impressed while working under Vikings DC Brian Flores before Washington hired him as DC.
Washington hired Jones from Flores' Vikings staff; he returned to Minnesota as DB coach in 2022 and became pass game coordinator in 2023.
Jones spent five seasons with the Vikings, four under head coach Kevin O'Connell, and was one of Brian Flores' most trusted defensive assistants the past three seasons.
Lions promoted tight ends coach Ben Johnson to OC; Campbell had retained him in 2021 and Johnson's role grew after Campbell took over play-calling.
Johnson left for the Bears head job after three seasons as Detroit's offensive coordinator.
Report that Campbell's Lions would promote TE coach Ben Johnson, who also overlapped with Campbell in Miami, to OC.
Bears hired former Saints head coach Dennis Allen as defensive coordinator under Ben Johnson.
AP: Allen, Sean Payton's defensive coordinator in New Orleans 2015-21 and Saints head coach 2022-24, became Bears DC.
Lions hired Dan Campbell, a Saints assistant from 2016 to 2020, after his 2015 interim stint as Dolphins head coach.
AP: Lions agreed to terms with Saints assistant head coach and tight ends coach Dan Campbell.
Campbell joined the Saints in 2016 as assistant head coach/TE coach under Sean Payton, choosing New Orleans partly to learn from his longtime mentor.
Profile: Campbell was Payton's right-hand man as Saints assistant head coach/TE coach since 2016, learning under him for five seasons.
Lions promoted linebackers coach Kelvin Sheppard to DC to replace Aaron Glenn, who left to coach the Jets; Sheppard joined Campbell's staff in 2021.
Dan Campbell's Lions promoted Sheppard, their linebackers coach under DC Aaron Glenn, to defensive coordinator.
Details the Lions' two-year plan, led by Campbell and Glenn, to groom Sheppard into their defensive coordinator.
Kevin Stefanski's Browns named Drew Petzing tight ends coach; he had spent six seasons alongside Stefanski in Minnesota.
Lions hired Petzing as OC; bio: Vikings 2014-19 (WR coach 2019), Browns TE coach 2020-21 and QB coach 2022, Cardinals OC 2023-25.
Petzing was Arizona's offensive coordinator for three seasons under head coach Jonathan Gannon before Detroit hired him.
Payton's career was shaped by mentors Jon Gruden and Bill Parcells; Parcells hired him in 2003 as Cowboys assistant head coach/QB coach and gave him play-calling.
Payton passed mentor Bill Parcells in career wins; he was a Cowboys assistant head coach under Parcells 2003-05.
Reid worked for Mike Holmgren on the Packers from 1992 to 1998, coaching tight ends, the offensive line, then quarterbacks in 1997-98.
Reid began coaching under Holmgren at BYU, spent seven years on Holmgren's Green Bay staff and became his QB coach in 1997.
